label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: De un talento de oro puro hizo a ella, y todos sus utensilios.
spanish: Un talento de oro puro hizo a ella, y todos sus utensilios.
grammarChanges: Removed the introductory "De" before "un talento de oro puro": the Hebrew is an absolute singular material/measure phrase placed in apposition before the verb, not a Spanish prepositional "from/of" phrase, so the unmarked "de" was adding a measure sense the tokens do not carry. "de oro puro" inside the phrase is kept, as it correctly renders the noun+adjective material description.
